design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4 & 5 FUSION: SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST + LUXURY DARK
description: A high-end, Awwwards-style portfolio landing page for Zeitix Labs. Moving away from the 'terminal AI slop' aesthetic into a highly credible, premium digital agency feel. Features intense kinetic typography, bento grids, and smooth scrolling.

global_strategy.emotion: Premium, structural, forward-thinking, and deeply human.
global_strategy.spacing_philosophy: Luxurious negative space. Sections must be separated by py-24 to py-32. Cards must have p-8 to p-12 inner padding.
global_strategy.alignment: Optical alignment over strict geometry. Generous use of asymmetry.
global_strategy.motion_philosophy: Premium purposeful motion. Smooth scrolling is mandatory. Elements reveal as if stepping into a physical gallery.

headings.usage: Massive typography for hero and section headers. Never default to generic sans.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively for sticky header. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Used to define bento cards and section dividers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows instead of drop shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(255,255,255,0.03)].
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background if possible, otherwise stark clean dark voids.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Massive kinetic typography staggered in via framer-motion. Background features a dark abstract 3D architectural element with parallax effect.

items: Zeitix Play: col-span-1 md:col-span-8 row-span-2 (Hero block)
Zeitix CRM: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 row-span-1 (Square block)
Zeitix Tools: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 row-span-1 (Square block)
Zeitix Grow: col-span-1 md:col-span-6 row-span-1 (Wide block)
Zeitix Build: col-span-1 md:col-span-6 row-span-1 (Wide block)

layouts_and_grids.roadmap: List format with custom Framer Motion progress bars filling up from 0% on scroll into view.
layouts_and_grids.contact: 2-column grid. Left: Direct links (Email, Phone, WhatsApp) with huge typography. Right: Minimalist Shadcn form with floating labels or very stark borders.

components_and_motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee. 'Editorial Ribbon' style. Slow drift, font-serif or clean mono, tracking wide, massive gaps between items (gap-32). Text: 'Zeitix Labs ✦ Evolving with Time ✦ Pune, India'
components_and_motion.scroll: @studio-freight/react-lenis is MANDATORY for wrapping the main app to provide premium smooth scrolling.
components_and_motion.reveal_animations: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveals. Use overflow-hidden on a wrapper div, and translate-y from 100% to 0% for child elements.
components_and_motion.hover_states: Bento cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and their borders brighten (border-white/30). Images inside cards slightly scale up (scale-105) on group-hover.

hero_bg.description: Abstract black and blue architectural geometry for subtle background immersion.

zeitix_crm.description: Premium salon storefront at night, representing CRM target.

zeitix_build.description: Collaborative modern office space for custom software build.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use default generic fonts like Inter for headings. Apply Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit from Google Fonts.
Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis at the root layout level for smooth scrolling. This is critical for the Awwwards feel.
The Hero section must use Framer Motion for a kinetic staggered line-by-line reveal of the text: 'We build products that evolve with time.'
Construct the 5 verticals (Play, CRM, Tools, Grow, Build) using a strict CSS Grid bento layout as specified in layouts_and_grids.
Images within bento cards must be constrained (max-h-[300px] or cover object-fit) and darkened via overlay (bg-black/50) to keep text legible.
Build the Contact form using Shadcn UI form primitives but strip away heavy borders, using a minimalist aesthetic with 1px border-white/10.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use sonner for toast notifications on form submission.
Include direct WhatsApp, Phone, and Email links using placeholder data (hello@zeitixlabs.com, etc) in the contact section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses text-shadow or gradient overlays. Text colors must meet 4.5:1 ratio.
